ana: Quick heads-up, launching a focused access-review next week: target ownerless admin roles + stale KMS grants (>180d). Canary in staging first.

jay: Scope? human admins + svcaccts only?

ana: correct. exclude customer Dedicated principals unless explicitly ownerless. plan: dry-run -> 10d owner notice -> prune.

mike: tooling tip: AWS grants filter example:
`aws kms list-grants --key-id KEYID | jq '.Grants[] | select(.CreateDate < "2023-09-01T00:00:00Z")'`
GCP: pull key iam policy + check IAM audit logs for lastGrantTime.

audit-bot: auto-scan: 8 ownerless admin bindings found (staging/infra), 4 KMS grants >180d. artifact: s3://redwood-audit/access-review/4190012345-evidence.zip

jay: propose dry-run Wed 10:00 PT in staging-auth. I'll run it and verify no auth regressions.

ana: comms: generate "ownerproof" (last-auth, last-rotate, linked-ticket) and send 10d notice -> escalate to TL. mike, can you add rollback rebind command to runbook?

mike: added `infractl iam bind --principal <PRINC> --role admin` to runbook and snapshot steps. will also block pruning within 14d of key rotation.

audit-bot: runbook updated and logging hook created to send removal events to #security-alerts.

jay: dry-run done, no failures in staging. opened PR to remove one orphan binding: https://git.redwood.com/org/infra/policy/PR-2401 (will wait 10d). will post logs after prune.

ana: thanks. keep artifacts in retention bucket for recert evidence and SOC will run post-prune smoke tests.

jay: ack :thumbsup:
